g.text: Residue of chain 3, numbered as in the structure file
An interface has no centre. The residues of chain 3 that touch
chains 1, 2 stand in a column, as boxes, ordered along the
interface and not by their sequence: neighbours in the column
are neighbours in space; those of chains 1, 2 around it. A line is
a pair of residues, at the shortest of its contacts of one kind.
All 11 residues of chain 3 at the interface are shown, with 18
